name: stri_omit_empty_na
title: Omit empty strings and missing values

origin.description: Alias of stri_remove_empty_na. Drops empty strings and missing values.
origin.details: This is stri_remove_empty_na, which calls stri_remove_empty(x, TRUE).

translation.description: Alias of stri_remove_empty_na. Drops empty strings and missing values.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings and stringi._na.NA.

translation.details: The same function as stri_remove_empty_na. Both "" and NA are removed.
translation.value: A list of the kept strings.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringi.utils import stri_omit_empty_na
print(stri_omit_empty_na(['a', NA, '', 'b']))
